simple.meaning: חָסַל (châçal) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to eat off.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Deuteronomy, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:38. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָסַל (H2628) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חָסַל (châçal) / H2628 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:38 with source-language evidence and verse context.
